g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
GTC Berlin 2026 local AI announcements: distinguishing
available features from upcoming releases
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-22
Check the event name first
This event is GTC Berlin, not the March GTC.
Why the three product lines should not
be treated as the same equipment
NVIDIA describes RTX Spark as a product for
running personal agents on Windows PCs, DGX
Spark as a product for development and scaling…
What is available now
NVIDIA’s official blog states that Underdog
Desktop Agent is available on RTX Spark.
What is coming on October 23 and later
this month
Supply of the DGX Spark 64GB system was
announced to begin through partners on Friday,
October 23.
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
